# General UI

General UI does not know Message, Conversation, the IM domain, or the Flare SDK, so any product can reuse it.

## Dependency

Foundation → General UI. General UI cannot depend on IM UI or product code.

## Catalog

Browse General, Layout, Navigation, Form, Data Display, Feedback, Overlay, and Media. Each component page exposes states, themes, viewports, and platforms directly.
